name: Search and content marketing
description: Universal pack. Load this on every site.

hasDefinedTerm.name: SEO
hasDefinedTerm.description: Improving a site's visibility in organic search results through content, technical structure, and authority.

hasDefinedTerm.name: SERP
hasDefinedTerm.description: The page of results returned for a query, including organic links, ads, and enriched features.

hasDefinedTerm.name: CTR
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of people who click a result after seeing it. Clicks divided by impressions.

hasDefinedTerm.name: impressions
hasDefinedTerm.description: The number of times a page appeared in search results, whether or not anyone clicked.

hasDefinedTerm.name: organic traffic
hasDefinedTerm.description: Visits arriving from unpaid search results.

hasDefinedTerm.name: search intent
hasDefinedTerm.description: What a searcher is actually trying to accomplish. Usually grouped as informational, navigational, commercial, or transactional.

hasDefinedTerm.name: keyword research
hasDefinedTerm.description: Identifying the queries an audience uses, and the volume and competition behind each.

hasDefinedTerm.name: search volume
hasDefinedTerm.description: How many times a query is searched in a given period, usually monthly.

hasDefinedTerm.name: keyword difficulty
hasDefinedTerm.description: An estimate of how hard it is to rank for a query, usually derived from the authority of pages already ranking.

hasDefinedTerm.name: long tail
hasDefinedTerm.description: Low-volume, highly specific queries. Individually small, collectively the majority of search demand.

hasDefinedTerm.name: head term
hasDefinedTerm.description: A short, high-volume query. Competitive, and usually ambiguous in intent.

hasDefinedTerm.name: SERP feature
hasDefinedTerm.description: Any non-standard result element such as a featured snippet, knowledge panel, or People Also Ask block.

hasDefinedTerm.name: featured snippet
hasDefinedTerm.description: An answer extracted from a page and shown above the standard results.

hasDefinedTerm.name: People Also Ask
hasDefinedTerm.description: The expandable related-question block in Google results. A useful map of sub-intents around a query.

hasDefinedTerm.name: knowledge panel
hasDefinedTerm.description: The entity summary box shown beside results, assembled from Google's knowledge graph.

hasDefinedTerm.name: local pack
hasDefinedTerm.description: The map plus three business listings shown for local-intent queries.

hasDefinedTerm.name: zero-click search
hasDefinedTerm.description: A search resolved on the results page itself, so no site receives the visit.

hasDefinedTerm.name: cannibalization
hasDefinedTerm.description: Several pages on one site competing for the same query, splitting signals between them.

hasDefinedTerm.name: crawling
hasDefinedTerm.description: The process of a search engine fetching pages from a site.

hasDefinedTerm.name: indexation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Whether a page has been stored in a search engine's index and is therefore eligible to rank.

hasDefinedTerm.name: crawl budget
hasDefinedTerm.description: The number of pages a search engine will fetch from a site in a given period. Matters mainly at large scale.

hasDefinedTerm.name: crawl depth
hasDefinedTerm.description: How many clicks from the homepage a page sits. Deeper pages are crawled less often.

hasDefinedTerm.name: robots.txt
hasDefinedTerm.description: A root-level file telling crawlers which paths they may request. It controls crawling, not indexing.

hasDefinedTerm.name: noindex
hasDefinedTerm.description: A directive asking search engines to keep a page out of the index while still allowing it to be crawled.

hasDefinedTerm.name: nofollow
hasDefinedTerm.description: A link attribute telling search engines not to pass authority through that link.

hasDefinedTerm.name: canonical tag
hasDefinedTerm.description: A link element naming the preferred version of a page, used to consolidate duplicates onto one URL.

hasDefinedTerm.name: XML sitemap
hasDefinedTerm.description: A machine-readable list of a site's URLs submitted to search engines to aid discovery.

hasDefinedTerm.name: redirect chain
hasDefinedTerm.description: Two or more redirects in sequence before reaching the final URL. Wastes crawl and leaks a little signal each hop.

hasDefinedTerm.name: 301 redirect
hasDefinedTerm.description: A permanent redirect. Passes nearly all ranking signal to the destination.

hasDefinedTerm.name: 302 redirect
hasDefinedTerm.description: A temporary redirect. Signals the original URL should stay indexed.

hasDefinedTerm.name: soft 404
hasDefinedTerm.description: A page that returns a success status while showing not-found content. Confuses indexing.

hasDefinedTerm.name: orphan page
hasDefinedTerm.description: A page with no internal links pointing to it, so crawlers and users can only reach it by direct URL.

hasDefinedTerm.name: faceted navigation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Filter-driven URLs on listing pages. A common source of near-duplicate pages and wasted crawl.

hasDefinedTerm.name: pagination
hasDefinedTerm.description: Splitting a long list across numbered pages. Needs care so crawlers reach deep items.

hasDefinedTerm.name: log file analysis
hasDefinedTerm.description: Reading server logs to see what crawlers actually requested, rather than what you assume they did.

hasDefinedTerm.name: hreflang
hasDefinedTerm.description: An annotation declaring the language and region a page targets, used to serve the right version internationally.

hasDefinedTerm.name: render budget
hasDefinedTerm.description: The limited resource search engines allocate to executing JavaScript before indexing a page.

hasDefinedTerm.name: client-side rendering
hasDefinedTerm.description: Building page content in the browser with JavaScript. Adds a rendering step before content can be indexed.

hasDefinedTerm.name: server-side rendering
hasDefinedTerm.description: Producing complete HTML on the server, so crawlers receive content without executing JavaScript.

hasDefinedTerm.name: static site generation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Pre-building pages at deploy time. The most crawl-friendly rendering strategy.

hasDefinedTerm.name: hydration
hasDefinedTerm.description: Attaching JavaScript behaviour to server-rendered HTML in the browser.

hasDefinedTerm.name: mobile-first indexing
hasDefinedTerm.description: Google's use of the mobile version of a page as the primary basis for indexing and ranking.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Core Web Vitals
hasDefinedTerm.description: Google's page-experience metrics covering loading, interactivity, and layout stability.

hasDefinedTerm.name: LCP
hasDefinedTerm.description: How long the largest visible element takes to render. A loading-speed metric.

hasDefinedTerm.name: CLS
hasDefinedTerm.description: How much visible content moves unexpectedly during load. A visual-stability metric.

hasDefinedTerm.name: INP
hasDefinedTerm.description: How quickly a page responds to user interaction. Replaced First Input Delay.

hasDefinedTerm.name: TTFB
hasDefinedTerm.description: Time to first byte. How long the server takes to begin responding.

hasDefinedTerm.name: field data
hasDefinedTerm.description: Performance measured from real visitors, as opposed to a synthetic lab test.

hasDefinedTerm.name: lazy loading
hasDefinedTerm.description: Deferring off-screen resources until they are needed. Helps loading speed, hurts indexing if applied to primary content.

hasDefinedTerm.name: structured data
hasDefinedTerm.description: Machine-readable annotations stating what a page's content means, rather than leaving a parser to infer it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: JSON-LD
hasDefinedTerm.description: The JSON serialization of linked data, and the format search engines prefer for structured data.

ctx.expansion: JavaScript Object Notation for Linked Data

hasDefinedTerm.name: schema.org
hasDefinedTerm.description: The shared vocabulary search engines use for structured data, maintained collaboratively by the major engines.

hasDefinedTerm.name: rich result
hasDefinedTerm.description: An enhanced search listing showing extra detail such as ratings, prices, or FAQs, driven by structured data.

hasDefinedTerm.name: entity
hasDefinedTerm.description: A distinct thing a search engine can identify and hold facts about: a person, product, place, or organization.

hasDefinedTerm.name: knowledge graph
hasDefinedTerm.description: A search engine's database of entities and the relationships between them.

hasDefinedTerm.name: disambiguation
hasDefinedTerm.description: Resolving which entity a name refers to when several share it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: DefinedTerm
hasDefinedTerm.description: A schema.org type for a term and its definition, groupable into a DefinedTermSet.

hasDefinedTerm.name: breadcrumb
hasDefinedTerm.description: A trail showing a page's position in the site hierarchy. Often rendered directly in search results.

hasDefinedTerm.name: topic cluster
hasDefinedTerm.description: A pillar page plus supporting pages on subtopics, interlinked to signal depth on a theme.

hasDefinedTerm.name: pillar page
hasDefinedTerm.description: The broad, central page of a topic cluster, linking out to its supporting detail pages.

hasDefinedTerm.name: content decay
hasDefinedTerm.description: The gradual traffic loss a page suffers as it ages and competitors publish fresher material.

hasDefinedTerm.name: content refresh
hasDefinedTerm.description: Updating an existing page rather than publishing a new one, usually the higher-return move.

hasDefinedTerm.name: content pruning
hasDefinedTerm.description: Removing or consolidating low-value pages to concentrate authority and reduce crawl waste.

hasDefinedTerm.name: thin content
hasDefinedTerm.description: A page with too little substance to satisfy the query it targets. Often generated at scale.

hasDefinedTerm.name: duplicate content
hasDefinedTerm.description: Substantially identical content at more than one URL, forcing engines to pick a version.

hasDefinedTerm.name: programmatic SEO
hasDefinedTerm.description: Generating many pages from a structured data source against a template. Powerful at scale, and the fastest route to thin content if unmanaged.

hasDefinedTerm.name: E-E-A-T
hasDefinedTerm.description: Experience, expertise, authoritativeness, and trust. Criteria in Google's quality rater guidelines, not a direct ranking factor.

hasDefinedTerm.name: YMYL
hasDefinedTerm.description: Your Money or Your Life. Topics where inaccuracy could cause real harm, held to a higher quality bar.

hasDefinedTerm.name: helpful content
hasDefinedTerm.description: Google's framing for material written primarily for people rather than for search engines.

hasDefinedTerm.name: title tag
hasDefinedTerm.description: The page title used as the clickable headline in search results.

hasDefinedTerm.name: meta description
hasDefinedTerm.description: A page summary search engines may use as the result snippet. Not a ranking factor, but it affects click-through.

hasDefinedTerm.name: H1
hasDefinedTerm.description: The primary heading of a page. One per page, describing what the page is about.

hasDefinedTerm.name: alt text
hasDefinedTerm.description: A text description of an image, used by screen readers and by image search.

hasDefinedTerm.name: internal linking
hasDefinedTerm.description: Links between pages on the same site. Distributes authority and signals which pages matter.

hasDefinedTerm.name: anchor text
hasDefinedTerm.description: The visible, clickable words in a link. Describes what the destination is about.

hasDefinedTerm.name: backlink
hasDefinedTerm.description: A link from another site pointing at yours. A long-standing signal of authority.

hasDefinedTerm.name: link equity
hasDefinedTerm.description: The ranking value passed through a link. Divided among the links on a page.

hasDefinedTerm.name: domain authority
hasDefinedTerm.description: A third-party score estimating a domain's ranking strength. Useful for comparison, not a Google metric.

hasDefinedTerm.name: digital PR
hasDefinedTerm.description: Earning coverage and links from publications through newsworthy material rather than outreach at volume.

hasDefinedTerm.name: toxic backlink
hasDefinedTerm.description: A link from a manipulative or low-quality source. Usually ignored rather than penalised.

hasDefinedTerm.name: brand mention
hasDefinedTerm.description: A reference to a brand without a link. Contributes to entity confidence even absent link equity.

hasDefinedTerm.name: GEO
hasDefinedTerm.description: Optimizing for inclusion and citation in generative search answers rather than classic ranked links.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AEO
hasDefinedTerm.description: Optimizing to be the answer an assistant returns, rather than a link a user clicks.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI Overviews
hasDefinedTerm.description: Google's generated summaries shown above traditional results, assembled from retrieved pages.

hasDefinedTerm.name: RAG
hasDefinedTerm.description: Retrieval-augmented generation. Retrieving source documents at query time and generating an answer grounded in them.

hasDefinedTerm.name: query fan-out
hasDefinedTerm.description: When a system decomposes one query into several sub-questions and retrieves against each.

hasDefinedTerm.name: chunking
hasDefinedTerm.description: Splitting content into passages for retrieval. Chunk boundaries decide what can be retrieved independently.

hasDefinedTerm.name: embedding
hasDefinedTerm.description: A numeric vector representing meaning, letting systems compare passages by similarity rather than keyword overlap.

hasDefinedTerm.name: vector search
hasDefinedTerm.description: Retrieval by meaning similarity rather than exact term matching.

hasDefinedTerm.name: citation
hasDefinedTerm.description: A generated answer's attribution to a source page. The GEO equivalent of a ranking position.

hasDefinedTerm.name: hallucination
hasDefinedTerm.description: A confident model output unsupported by any source. Grounding in retrieved documents reduces but does not remove it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: llms.txt
hasDefinedTerm.description: A proposed root-level file offering LLM-oriented site guidance. Adoption and effect remain contested.

hasDefinedTerm.name: AI crawler
hasDefinedTerm.description: A bot collecting content for model training or retrieval, distinct from a search indexing crawler.

hasDefinedTerm.name: grounding
hasDefinedTerm.description: Constraining a generated answer to retrieved source material so claims can be traced.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Google Search Console
hasDefinedTerm.description: Google's first-party reporting for impressions, clicks, indexing, and technical issues.

hasDefinedTerm.name: GA4
hasDefinedTerm.description: The current version of Google Analytics, built on an event-based data model.

hasDefinedTerm.name: attribution
hasDefinedTerm.description: Assigning credit for a conversion across the touchpoints that preceded it.

hasDefinedTerm.name: share of voice
hasDefinedTerm.description: A brand's visibility across a tracked keyword set relative to competitors.

hasDefinedTerm.name: conversion rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of visitors who complete a target action.

hasDefinedTerm.name: bounce rate
hasDefinedTerm.description: The share of sessions with no qualifying engagement. Directional, and easy to misread.
